summary: A 54-year-old Longmont woman drowned in the Gunnison River south of Garlic Mike's; Gunnison County Communications received a missing-rafter report on Monday and swift-water rescue, law enforcement and EMS conducted an extensive search by raft, foot and air (plane with spotter). She was recovered from the river and taken to Gunnison Valley Hospital, where she died.
location: Gunnison River south of Garlic Mike's
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office; swift water rescue; Gunnison-area law enforcement and EMS
notes: Name withheld to protect the family (per Sheriff Rick Besecker); sheriff unsure whether she was caught in an eddy or her raft flipped; 2015-06-15 Monday-verified; Gunnison's first indexed 2015-06 row.
